_comment: Run it with: PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run --group studio langgraph dev
PYTHONUTF8=1 is REQUIRED on a cp949 Windows box. Without it three separate reads die
with UnicodeDecodeError: this file, ai/.env, and langgraph_api's own bundled openapi.json.
Keep this file ASCII anyway so the failure mode is one thing, not three.
See src/modi_ai/studio.py for why graphs points at a separate graph object.
